name: agentd-primer-probe-server
description: OligoSmith 引物与探针设计、验证、优化和报告生成 MCP 服务
target_platform: Linux server with Docker Engine and Compose v2

minimum_resources.database_disk: depends on mounted BLAST and FASTA resources

authentication: Bearer JWT for MCP and workflow mutations; read-only WF-01 deliverables are public by deployment default
persistent_state: agentd-jobs Docker volume for jobs and HiMat input artifacts plus optional RustFS S3 publication for user attachments
external_data: versioned target and internal-control FASTA files
RustFS S3 endpoint and least-privilege credentials when attachment publication is enabled
offline_note: Build on a connected Linux Docker host and run deploy/scripts/export_offline_image.sh.
